title: Novel roles for Klf1 in regulating the erythroid transcriptome revealed by mRNA-seq

atlas_processing.source_statement: Expression Atlas mapped reads to Ensembl release 97 with HISAT2 2.1.0 and quantified them with FeatureCounts 1.6.2. Exact FASTA and annotation hashes remain to be pinned.
atlas_processing.diagnostic_baseline: Diagnostic OLS on log2(median-ratio-normalized counts + 1), genotype only; DESeq2 confirmation remains required.

verified_resources.format_check: Every retained count parsed as a non-negative integer; repeated run columns, where present, were accepted only after full-vector equality checks.
Analysed run identifiers are present, unique and represented in the retained count matrix.
